text:
alex: Heads up — onboarding SolarWind's customer finetune (delta weights) into our falconx-13b-adapt runtime hit a tokenization/compat issue when running int4 quantized variant. Seen in staging after the merge: some prompts truncate and outputs repeat.

sanjay: ugh. do we have a minimal repro? any changed tokenizer files in the patch?

alex: quick summary: the finetune bundle included a small custom tokenizer tweak (added 3 combined tokens for product names). The LoRA-like deltas were merged via our stitcher but we didn't surface the tokenizer diff during model spec validation. Repro command: 

```
# serve locally with int4 profile
ri serve --model falconx-13b-adapt:sv1 --quantize int4 --token-limit 512
curl -sS localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"SolarWind status: "}' | jq .text
```

Output shows prompt truncated to "Solar" and then repeating token sequence. Logs include: 

```
WARN tokenizer: unknown token sequence length mismatch: 3 -> 2
ERROR runtime: kv-cache misalign detected at step=12
```

mina: was the tokenizer change in the diff just added tokens or remapped ids? If ids shifted, int4 packing could break.

alex: it added 3 new composite tokens and updated vocab.json. Merging kept the old vocab order in the base artifact, but the finetune expected the new indices. So mismatch.

eva: ran a small quick-eval pack (customer-keyed) on staging before and after merge — table: 

```
metric,baseline,after-merge
perplexity,17.2,19.8
instruction-acc,0.88,0.74
named-entities-f1,0.91,0.64
```
Significant drop on named entities (SolarWind product names) — makes sense.

sanjay: ok plan: 1) block promoted merge until vocab sync; 2) add a merge-time tokenizer check to the model spec validator that compares vocab hashes; 3) create a fallback mapping layer at serving that remaps finetune token ids to base ids when possible. Thoughts?

mina: +1. The serving remap should be opt-in for Private deployments (privacy concerns) and auto-enabled for Dedicated where we control artifacts. Need to be careful with KV cache alignment — remap must run pre-tokenize or as a token id translation step before KV indexing.

alex: I'll revert the deployment and open a PR to add the vocab-hash check in the stitcher. Also uploading a tiny script to regenerate proper merged tokenizer ordering for this finetune. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1328

deploy-bot: smoke-check: staging/falconx-13b-adapt:int4 — FAILED — regression detected on quick-eval pack 'solarwind-qep' (delta perplexity +2.6). See /ci/2233 for logs. :rotating_light:

eva: attaching the minimal tokenizer diff we saw: 

```
- "token_4250": "Solar",
- "token_4251": "Wind",
+ "token_4250": "SolarWind",
+ "token_4251": "SolarWind/Edge",
+ "token_4252": "SolarWind/Cloud",
```

That explains the NN expecting a 1-token span where the base had 2 tokens.

sanjay: can we add a unit test in model-onboard that simulates quantized runtime (int4) and ensures vocab->ids stable? cheap check: compare tokenization counts for a set of anchor prompts.

mina: I'll draft the serving remap prototype (python) and include a toggle flag. Also propose an alerting rule: if named-entity F1 drops >0.15 post-merge, block rollout.

alex: thanks. Action items: alex revert/promote-block, sanjay add unit check in stitcher, mina prototype remap, eva run extended qep with mapping once prototype ready. I'll update the customer success thread to notify SolarWind.

eva: adding to postmortem notes: "tokenizer-index drift during finetune merge" and recommend adding tokenizer artifact diff to onboarding checklist.

mina: 👍 will ping when prototype is ready for review.

alex: closing loop — creating an internal ticket RI-9876 to track fixes + postmortem.
